verdict.rationale: AskFred is Fireflies' first-party AI assistant for natural-language questions about meeting transcripts. It can search across multiple meetings for context-aware answers and keeps context across follow-up questions. The MCP server and ChatGPT Deep Research integration add another way to query meeting data in natural language. Missing for 10: no evidence that answers cite or link back to the source meetings or timestamps, no explicit confirmation that search covers the entire meeting history rather than a selected set, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
